descriptions.zh:
我们位于[This.GetName]的殖民者有了瞠目结舌的发现。在偏僻的山脉深处，他们碰巧撞见了一座神秘的结构，根据我们的扫描，这座建筑在我们第一次调查[This.GetPlanetMoon]的时候还不在那里。它的状态完好无损，就像是刚刚建造的一样，但是没有证据表明[Owner.GetAdj]参与了建造。事实上，它的构型显示出种种异星特征，曲边和拱角非常的不寻常，完全有悖于我们的美学感知。

在它的入口，有一个标志，上面写着（很神奇，用的是我们的语言）：“欢迎来到壮阔秀丽的跨次元异常点迷宫。进入者自行承担风险。”
descriptions.en:
Our colonists on [This.GetName] have made a startling discovery. Deep in a remote mountain range, they stumbled across a mysterious structure that, according to our scans, was not there when we first surveyed the [This.GetPlanetMoon]. Its condition is excellent, almost as if it was newly built, but there is no evidence of [Owner.GetAdj] involvement in its construction. In fact, its architecture shows alien characteristics, with curves and angles that appear unusual and even disturbing to our aesthetic sensibilities.

At its entrance, there is a sign (in our language, curiously) with the words "Welcome to the Magnificent Labyrinth of Exotic Trans-Dimensional Anomalies. Enter at your own risk."

label.en: We don't have time for this.

descriptions.zh:
看上去[Target.GetName]上的这个异星迷宫在试图吸引我们的注意。我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]很不情愿将这么一个事物归为一栋建筑，但是恐怕我们只能这么认为：迷宫现在不再坐落于遥远的群山之中，而是距离我们的一个主要居住点很短的距离。一天接一天，它令人费解地变换着自己的位置，而且其入口的那个警告标志也消失了——事实上，它看上去好像……在邀请我们。

尽管有些好奇宝宝忍不住头铁进去了，我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]还是劝告谨慎对待。唯一清楚的是，我们不能再满足于从远处观察迷宫了——必须采取新的方案。
descriptions.en:
It appears that the alien labyrinth on [Target.GetName] is attempting to attract our attention. Our [Owner.GetResearchers] are loath to ascribe such agency to a building, but that is the only way to put it: the labyrinth is now no longer situated in a remote mountain pass, but is now instead located a short distance from one of our main settlements. From one day to the next, it inexplicably shifted its location, and the warning signs at the entrance have disappeared - in fact, it now looks... inviting.

While some are curious to enter, our [Owner.GetResearchers] urge caution. What is clear, however, is that we can no longer content ourselves with observing the labyrinth - a new approach will be necessary.

descriptions.zh:
看上去[Target.GetName]上的这个异星迷宫在试图吸引我们的注意。尽管一栋建筑会有任何形式的意识这一点看上去很不可思议，但是恐怕我们只能这么认为：迷宫现在不再坐落于遥远的群山之中，而是距离我们的一个主要存储区域很短的距离。一天接一天，它令人费解地变换着自己的位置，而且其入口的那个警告标志也消失了——事实上，它看上去好像……在邀请我们。

这一改变的出现，会让我们阻止[owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]闯入其中更加的困难，除非我们拉警戒线隔绝这片区域。
descriptions.en:
It appears that the alien labyrinth on [Target.GetName] is attempting to attract our attention. While it seems surprising that a building would possess any form of consciousness, that is the only way to put it: the labyrinth is now no longer situated in a remote mountain pass, but is now instead located a short distance from one of our main storage areas. From one day to the next, it inexplicably shifted its location, and the warning signs at the entrance have disappeared - in fact, it now looks... inviting.

This change will make it harder to prevent any [owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] from stumbling into it, unless we make an effort to cordon off the area.

label.zh: 隔离这片区域——谁都不允许进入！
label.en: Cordon off the area - none may enter!

这个迷宫似乎对于我们毫不重视的态度闹脾气了。整个结构开始逐渐发生改变，从一幢冷峻的摩天大楼变成了富丽堂皇的宫殿，看上去令人感到很舒适。警告危险的标志已经消失了；现在，可爱的[Owner.Species.GetClass][Owner.Species.GetSpawnNamePlural]在入口附近爬来爬去，祈求我们的关注。除此之外，不知怎的，入口里面视线的尽头，似乎显露出的是无边无际的沙滩以及无止尽的明媚阳光。

我们的[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]看到这个改变都呆了，现在要阻止人进入这个结构可以说是难上加难。
descriptions.en:
The labyrinth appears to resent our lack of attention. The entire structure has gradually changed in appearance, morphing from a forbidding edifice into what looks remarkably like a pleasure palace. Gone is the sign warning of danger; now, adorable [Owner.Species.GetClass] [Owner.Species.GetSpawnNamePlural] crawl around the entrance, begging for attention, and somehow, the insides give the impression of vast beaches and unending sunrises just beyond sight.

Our [Root.Owner.GetResearchers] are bemused at the changes, and it is becoming ever harder to prevent anyone from entering the structure.

descriptions.zh: 迷宫已经不在了。从某一天开始，它就消失得无影无踪了。在原来的地址上，有一张小纸条留给了我们：“尽管我们的最初意图是使用我们的设施研究你们这个位面的生命体，你们禁欲式的拒绝进入也从另一方面给我们上了生动的一课。我们现在有了丰富的经验——它将成为我们研究经历中最有用的成果。作为我们善意的象征，我们在研究实验室中留下了一个微小的时空异常现象。我们希望它对于你们来说足够…有趣。”
descriptions.en: The labyrinth is gone. From one day to the next, it simply disappeared. On its site, a message was left for us: "Although it was our intention to study the Beings of your Dimension within our facility, your obstinate refusal to enter despite all the temptations offered has been an education of its own. We are left enriched by the experience - it will prove most useful to our... endeavors. As a token of our goodwill, we leave you a minor space-time anomaly at the site of our laboratory. We hope it will prove... diverting, to you."

descriptions.zh:
尽管迷宫展现出非比寻常的特性，事实证明它依然捱不过我们的重武器。当它轰然倒塌时，只有卵石遍地。

不幸的是，我们没法从断壁残垣中榨取什么有用的情报，好在从建材中我们设法回收了一些异星材料。
descriptions.en:
Despite its unusual properties, the labyrinth proved no match for our heavy weaponry. Where it lay, only rubble remains.

Unfortunately, we have not managed to glean much from the wreckage, but some of the exotic elements used in its construction are salvageable.

descriptions.zh: 迷宫不存在了。从某一天开始，它就凭空消失了。它原先矗立的地方什么也没有留下，只剩下我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]对着原来迷宫在的地方无能狂怒。或许什么都不知道，我们反而更安全一些吧。
descriptions.en: The labyrinth is gone. From one day to the next, it simply vanished. Nothing remains on the site where it once stood, leaving our [Owner.GetResearchers] baffled as to what it was all about. But perhaps we are safer not knowing.

label.en: A threat is lifted from us.

descriptions.zh:
我们派去调查迷宫的[Owner.GetResearchers]刚一进入，我们同他们的通讯链接就被切断了。我们焦急地等待，但是几天以来没有收到任何消息。随着时间流逝，我们不得不放弃搜寻我们失踪的人。

接着，正当我们放弃一切希望的时候，他们重新冒了出来！然后，这只是带给我们更多的问题：[Owner.GetResearchers]宣称完全不记得他们在迷宫里待过，然后他们的探险记录也被严重篡改。不仅如此，尽管他们只在迷宫里经过了几周，他们看上去却像老了好几岁！
descriptions.en:
Our communication link to the [Owner.GetResearchers] we sent into the labyrinth was cut off almost as soon as they entered. Nothing was heard for several days as we waited anxiously. As time passed, we resigned ourselves to the loss of our people.

Then, once all hope was lost, they reemerged! However, this has only raised further questions: the [Owner.GetResearchers] claim to have no memory of their stay within the labyrinth, and their recordings of their expedition are horribly garbled. Furthermore, even though they were in the labyrinth for a matter of weeks, they seem to have aged several years!

options.script: name = DISCONCERTING

descriptions.zh:
对迷宫的进一步探索带来了各种各样的结果，有时是令人不安的那种。有一次，[Owner.GetResearchers]进入后没过几秒就出来了，而且回答不出为什么这么快就返回。而在另一次，他们消失在迷宫中长达数周，但回来后却似乎比去之前更加年轻了，记忆也随之出现了数年的空缺。一些队员返回时容光焕发，而某些队员却是身受重伤。

随着时间推移，入口处的警示不断改变，“进入者自行承担风险”变成了“擅闯者死”，最后则是“警告！警告！不要进入迷宫，否则整颗星球就会灰飞烟灭”。墙壁上毛骨悚然，嵌入着[Owner.GetAdj][Owner.Species.GetRemnantNamePlural]的躯壳，然而最近没有出现不明的失踪事件，因此我们也不知道他们究竟是从哪里来的。

目前尚不清楚更进一步的研究究竟会带来什么，正如[Owner.GetResearchers]说的那样，我们无法证实或者证伪这些警告。然而，这已经使得自愿进入迷宫的人数量骤减。
descriptions.en:
Further expeditions into the labyrinth have yielded varying, at times unnerving results. On one occasion, our [Owner.GetResearchers] were in for mere seconds, and could give no answer as to why they turned back so quickly. On another, they were gone for weeks, but came back seemingly younger than they had left, and with year-long gaps in their memories. Some groups returned in a better physical state than they had left; others bore fresh scars of serious injuries.

Over time, the sign at the entrance has changed, too. "Enter at your own risk" became "Danger of death," and finally "WARNING! WARNING! Do not enter the labyrinth. If you do, the planet will explode." In a macabre touch, [Owner.GetAdj] [Owner.Species.GetRemnantNamePlural] adorn the walls - though exactly where they came from is not apparent, since there have been no recent unexplained disappearances.

It is not clear what further study will bring - as our [Owner.GetResearchers] point out, we have no way to confirm or deny the warning stated on the sign. It is, however, becoming ever harder to find volunteers to enter the labyrinth.

descriptions.zh:
那些警告最终没有成真，迷宫的消失没有毁灭[Target.GetName]。不过，它可不是消失得毫无痕迹：地震席卷了整个大地，沉睡的火山从睡梦中苏醒。

在一片狼藉中，迷宫还是留下了一条信息：“我们感谢你们如此友好地允许我们研究你们这个位面的生命体。事实证明，我们的……努力获得了回报。对于我们的离开时造成的混乱，我们深表歉意，这是因为我们无法从异次元安全部获得足够的资金用于顺利撤离。作为我们善意的象征，我们在研究实验室中留下了一个微小的时空异常现象。我们希望它对于你们来说足够…有趣。”
descriptions.en:
Contrary to its warnings, the labyrinth's disappearance did not destroy [Target.GetName]. However, it certainly left its mark: earthquakes ravaged the land, and volcanoes, long-dormant, erupted into life.

Amidst the widespread destruction, a message was left behind: "We thank you for so kindly allowing us to study the Beings of your Dimension. It has proven most useful to our... endeavors. We apologize for the inconvenience our departure causes - we were not able to secure necessary funding from the Ministry of Extradimensional Security for a smooth withdrawal. As a token of our goodwill, we leave you a minor space-time anomaly at the site of our laboratory. We hope it will prove... diverting."

label.zh: 我们应当深挖它的秘密。
label.en: We shall delve into its secrets.

descriptions.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]的殖民者汇报了一个奇怪的现象：在他们一个主要殖民定居点外，“雪”开始聚集起来。

好吧，“雪”只是他们用来描述这种物质的代名词。显而易见的是这肯定不是真正的雪，因为[Root.GetName]可是一颗沙漠星球，即使在两极地区温度也极少降到冰点以下。而且，也没有任何人目击到这些东西从天而降。不过，初步的扫描显示这种物质确实主要由冰冻的水构成，至于为什么不会融化仍不清楚。我们的[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]希望能进一步研究它的性质，而另一些人则认为它会带来危险，并希望能把这些雪弄走。
descriptions.en:
Our colonists on [Root.GetName] report a strange phenomenon: snow has begun gathering outside of one of their main colonial settlements.

Well, "snow" is the term they have used to describe it, anyway. It would seem implausible that it is real snow, given that [Root.GetName] is a desert planet where temperatures are seldom below freezing, even in the polar regions. Besides, there were no sightings of it actually falling from the sky. Nevertheless, initial readings suggest that the substance does indeed consist mainly of frozen water - though quite why it's not melting is unclear. Our [Root.Owner.GetResearchers] are eager to investigate its properties, but others caution that it may be dangerous and want it removed.

descriptions.zh:
[Target.GetName]上的“雪”增殖了起来。从起初的一小片突然爆发性增长，覆盖了越来越大面积的沙漠，现在已经到了影响交通和耕种系统的程度。大家越来越担心，如果雪不停止生长，殖民地很有可能会变得难以自持。

我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]在徒劳地寻找这种异象的解释。当从主体上分离开时，这些雪很快就熔化了，只留下了一点点有机残余物。我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]将这些残余物解释为维系这些雪的整体性的原因，通过未知的化学过程，使雪不受外界热量影响。然而，他们也表明这只是目前为止最有可能的猜测，尽管仍在努力，但对这些奇怪的物质目前还知之甚少。
descriptions.en:
The snow on [Target.GetName] has been multiplying. The initial small patch has swelled to cover an ever-expanding area of the desert, to the point that it is interfering with our transport and cultivation networks. If it does not stop growing soon, there are growing concerns that the colony will be unable to continue to support itself.

Our [Owner.GetResearchers] on the planet have sought, in vain, to explain the phenomenon. When removed from the main body, the snow quickly melts, leaving behind only some organic matter. Our [Owner.GetResearchers] theorize that this residue is causing the snow to maintain its integrity, sheltering it from heat via an unknown chemical reaction. However, they caution that this is only their best guess, and they have managed to find out very little about the strange compound.

label.en: Best keep an eye on it.

descriptions.zh:
这些“雪”似乎很抗拒被移除。尽管我们可以从其主体上取下小块使其融化，但这对阻止其势不可挡的增殖似乎收效甚微，而更激进的手段目前为止统统失败了——整个行动过程中围绕着一连串神秘的机械故障。

更糟糕的是，有越来越多的报告称，在受到“雪”影响的范围内有殖民者失踪。这些事件似乎是有所关联的，而这些雪可能是有生命，而且有恶意的。
descriptions.en:
The snow, it appears, is resistant to being removed. While we are able to remove small parts of it from the main body and melt it in that manner, this has done little to halt its onward march, and more invasive attempts to destroy it have so far failed - a spate of mysterious mechanical failures has surrounded the entire effort.

What is worse, there have been increasing reports of colonists disappearing in areas affected by the snow. It seems likely that they are connected and the snow is alive - and malicious.

descriptions.zh:
[Target.GetName]上的雪正在以相当危险的速度增殖，现在已经覆盖了行星赤道附近相当不小的一片区域。我们的军事领袖警告道，如果我们想要阻止它的蔓延就需要采取激进手段。然而，另外一些人则认为目前为止这只是个无关痛痒的小麻烦，还不至于说是威胁，而且它也在避免直接占领已殖民的区域。他们认定这东西真的有生命，并认为我们需要寻求与之沟通对话。

不管怎么样，我们可以活动的空间已经越来越狭小了。
descriptions.en:
The snow on [Target.GetName] is spreading at a quite alarming rate, and now covers a not-insignificant portion of the planet's equatorial areas. Our military leaders warn that drastic action is needed immediately if we are to halt its advance. However, more level heads point out that it has been a nuisance rather than a menace so far, and it has avoided directly occupying inhabited areas. They posit that it is clearly alive, and argue that we should seek to open dialog with it.

Either way, our room for maneuver is rapidly shrinking.

label.zh: 我们得搞明白它到底想要怎么样。
label.en: We must find out what it wants.

label.zh: 我们得搞明白它到底想要怎么样。

descriptions.zh: 我们收到了一些令人担忧的汇报，事关[Target.GetName]的“雪的问题”。似乎有数名殖民者在去“打雪仗”之后失踪了。与他们的联络已经中断了数日，而且我们已经无法找到任何他们的踪迹了，活不见人死不见尸。我们现在已经对当地殖民者通告，不要与这些雪有任何形式的接触，直到我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]找到更多的线索——或者找到那些失踪的人口。
descriptions.en: We have heard concerning reports regarding the "snow problem" on [Target.GetName]. It appears that several of our colonists have gone missing, having set off to engage in a "snowball fight." Contact was lost with them several days ago, but we have been unable to find any trace of them - living or dead. Colonists are being advised to avoid all contact with the snow, until our [Owner.GetResearchers] can find out more about it - or the lost settlers are found.

tooltips.en: The cost of observing the snow increases to £unity£ §R15§! §YUnity§! a month.

descriptions.zh: 在[Target.GetName]上雪的扩散对我们的殖民者而言已经不仅仅是什么新奇小事了，现在它还带了了一些困难。它对生态系统造成了剧烈的影响，许多当地的动植物种群承受了巨大的压力。目前从受影响地区已迁出了大量移民。然而出乎意料的是，有另一些物种在这种新的寒冷环境中欣欣向荣。我们的气候学家敦促对事态进展的关注，并称其为观察正在进行中的非[Owner.GetAdj]操控气候变化的“百年难得一遇”的好机会。
descriptions.en: The spread of the snow on [Target.GetName] has not just been a source of novelty - and difficulty - for our colonists. It has also caused rapid changes to the ecosystem, with various native species of flora and fauna put under enormous strain. Already, there have been massive migrations away from the affected areas. However, to our surprise, certain other species have thrived in the new, colder conditions. Our climatologists eagerly observe the developments, calling it a "once in a lifetime" opportunity to watch rapid non-[Owner.GetAdj] controlled climate change in action.

descriptions.zh:
你们的出现给我们带来了智慧。我们通过进食你们的失踪个体学会了新的思考和生存方式。不过你们似乎想毁灭我们。我们还不清楚这个存在状态，这种智能到底意味着什么。我们希望可以在这颗星球的角落寻找到属于自己的一席之地，我们可以无拘无束地探索自身。

如果你们不允许我们这么做，那要注意我们并不打算放弃我们的新形态。在必要的情况下我们会保卫自己。
descriptions.en:
Your presence has given us intelligence. We have fed off your Lost Ones to learn new ways of thinking, new ways of existing. We do not yet know what this state of being - this sapience - means. It is our wish to seclude ourselves to a corner of our planet, where we can have free rein to explore what it is to be us.

If you do not allow us this, be warned that we are not yet willing to give up our new existence. We will defend ourselves, if necessary.

tooltips.zh: §R我们必须抗争以维持行星的控制权§!
tooltips.en: §RWe must fight to keep control of the planet§!

label.zh: 我们可以分享一些土地。

tooltips.zh: §R我们必须抗争以维持行星的控制权§!
tooltips.en: §RWe must fight to keep control of the planet§!

descriptions.zh: 我们失去了对[FromFrom.GetName]的控制，它被§Y活雪§!夺走了！在[FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon]的生态系统中已经开始发生非常明显的变化。我们的[This.GetResearchers]提醒，除非我们能尽快夺回[FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon]，否则它的构造变化很快将使我们无法再继续居住。
descriptions.en: We have lost control of [FromFrom.GetName] - which has been seized by the §YLiving Snow§!! Already, significant changes are happening to the [FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon]'s ecosystem. Our [This.GetResearchers] warn that, unless we can retake the [FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon], its makeup will soon be changed beyond our ability to inhabit it.

options.script:
name = WORRYING
custom_tooltip = situation.190.tooltip

tooltips.zh: §R我们应该尽快夺回行星，否则就来不及了！§!
tooltips.en: §RWe should retake the planet, before it's too late!§!

descriptions.zh: 随着活雪对[Root.GetName]控制权的巩固，[Root.GetPlanetMoon]也变得越来越冷，它的大气条件在越来越快地发生改变。可以说，这颗星球现在已经不可居住了。目前暂不清楚我们是否能够将其恢复到之前的状态……不过我们的[saved_owner.GetResearchers]确信，在这些雪发现了自身的新存在形态，并通过自身独特的化学反应将整个[Root.GetName]变得天翻地覆之后，我们可以通过研究这些雪的独特行为学会许多有趣的东西。
descriptions.en: With the Living Snow consolidating its control over [Root.GetName], the [Root.GetPlanetMoon] has become ever colder, its atmospheric conditions changing at an ever-increasing rate. Now, the world can no longer be considered inhabitable. It is unclear whether we will ever be able to restore it to its former state... but our [saved_owner.GetResearchers] assure us that much of interest can be learned by observing the antics of the snow as it discovers its new state of being - and its unique chemical reactions which have wrought such change upon [Root.GetName].

descriptions.zh:
由于与太空垃圾发生意外碰撞，§Y[gravity_well_station.GetName]§!已经偏离了最佳稳定运转轨道，现在正缓缓落入最近的黑洞。这一事故使得整个空间站陷入了危险，但同时也是一个绝佳的研究黑洞、虹吸大量§H暗物质§!的契机。

应急推进器已经就绪准备修正空间站的轨道。
descriptions.en:
Due to an unexpected collision with a chunk of space debris, the §Y[gravity_well_station.GetName]§! has deviated from its innermost stable circular orbit and is now slowly closing the distance towards the nearby black hole. While the accident puts the whole station at risk, it is also an incredible opportunity to study the black hole and siphon huge quantities of §HDark Matter§!.

Emergency thrusters have been deployed to correct the station's orbit.

label.zh: 围绕黑洞稳定空间站轨道。
label.en: Stabilize the station's orbit around the black hole.
Get as close as possible to the black hole.

descriptions.zh:
神迹出现了！受到宗教狂热的驱使，§Y[Target.GetName]§!上虔诚的[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]已夺取了空间站的控制权。据他们称，他们获得了启示，现在打算径直前往黑洞中心，履行一桩自我毁灭的精神使命。

武装人员目前正在试图夺回空间站的控制权。
descriptions.en:
An epiphany! Driven by religious fervor, pious [Root.Owner.GetResearchers] aboard the §Y[Target.GetName]§! have seized control of the station. They claim to have received a vision, and are now heading straight to the center of the black hole in a spiritual quest for self-annihilation.

Armed personnel are currently fighting to regain control of the station.

descriptions.zh:
在§Y[Target.GetName]§!上的[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]被狂热冲昏了头脑，他夺取了空间站的控制权，并将其慢慢拐向黑洞——这番行为显然是出于近乎病态的科学好奇心、严重的鲁莽和对自己生命的彻底漠视。

武装人员目前正在试图夺回空间站的控制权。
descriptions.en:
Overenthusiastic [Root.Owner.GetResearchers] aboard the §Y[Target.GetName]§! have seized control of the station and are now steering it towards the black hole - a move doubtlessly driven by insatiable scientific curiosity, an unhealthy amount of recklessness, and utter disregard for their own self-preservation.

Armed personnel are currently fighting to regain control of the station.

tooltips.zh: 局势解决方案已锁定为“前进”。
tooltips.en: Situation approach locked to Advance.

descriptions.zh:
“我们已经见过舰船被事件视界捕获后会发生什么了！我不想摊上这么个死法！”

在咆哮出他们的抗命之词后，我们的一位[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]夺取了空间站的控制权，并且将其缓缓驶离黑洞。

武装人员目前正在试图夺回空间站的控制权。此外，涉及到这一事故的相关物理知识将会从课本当中删除。
descriptions.en:
'We've seen what happens to ships caught in the event horizon! I don't intend to die like that!'

After screaming their defiance, one of our [Root.Owner.GetResearchers] seized control of the station and is now steering it away from the black hole.

Armed personnel are currently fighting to regain control of the station, and the incident referenced is being expunged from our physics textbooks.

descriptions.zh:
惊慌的[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]现在控制住了空间站并将其缓缓驶离黑洞。

武装人员目前正在试图夺回空间站的控制权。
descriptions.en:
Terrified [Root.Owner.GetResearchers] have seized control of the station and are now steering it away from the black hole.

Armed personnel are currently fighting to regain control of the station.

tooltips.zh: 局势解决方案已锁定为“撤退”。
tooltips.en: Situation approach locked to Retreat.

descriptions.zh: 经过了紧张的对峙，哗变人员最终被制服了，武装人员重新夺回了§Y[Target.GetName]§!的控制权。
descriptions.en: After a tense confrontation, the mutineers have been dealt with, and armed personnel have regained full control of §Y[Target.GetName]§!.

options.script:
name = EXCELLENT
custom_tooltip = situation.513.tooltip

tooltips.zh: 局势解决方案现在可以手动变更了。
tooltips.en: Situation approach can again be manually changed.

descriptions.zh: 在接近黑洞的过程中，时空以出乎意料的方式发生了弯曲，而§Y[Target.GetName]§!的仪器也在艰难运转。经过对船上的仪器进行细致的重校准后，我们才发现这座空间站比我们之前预料的更加接近黑洞。
descriptions.en: When approaching a black hole, spacetime bends in unpredictable ways, and §Y[Target.GetName]§!'s instruments are struggling to keep up. After a careful recalibration of the onboard instruments, the station was shown to be much closer to the black hole than we previously thought.

descriptions.zh: §Y[Target.GetName]§!与黑洞的超近距离使其[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]能获取海量的数据，大大推动了我们对物理学最基本定律的理解。
descriptions.en: §Y[Target.GetName]§!'s proximity to the black hole allowed its [Root.Owner.GetResearchers] to gather a vast amount of data, furthering our understanding of the most fundamental laws of physics.

descriptions.zh: 我们的一位[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]提出了一种拯救§Y[Target.GetName]§!避免其毁灭的绝妙方案：通过拆解空间站的外部模块和设备并将它们丢入黑洞，这座空间站应该会获得足够的动量以逃逸黑洞的引力束缚。注意，只是说“应该”，这一决策背后的理论从未得到实验的验证。
descriptions.en: One of our [Root.Owner.GetResearchers] has devised a clever plan to save §Y[Target.GetName]§! from its fate: by stripping away any extraneous modules and equipment and hurling them into the black hole, the station should gain enough momentum to escape the black hole's gravitational pull. In this case, 'should' is the operative word: the theory behind this decision has never before been tested.

tooltips.zh: 拆除§Y[Target.GetName]§!上的所有建筑，以尝试减少§Y局势进展§!。
tooltips.en: Removes all Buildings from §Y[Target.GetName]§! in an attempt to decrease §Ysituation progress§!.

label.zh: 这是在无谓地浪费资源。

options.script: name = "situation.540.b"

descriptions.zh: §Y[Target.GetName]§!上的人员拆除了空间站的模块之后，将它们全部扔向黑洞。空间站和模块分离时产生的动量成功推动了空间站远离黑洞。
descriptions.en: After stripping the station of its modules, the personnel aboard §Y[Target.GetName]§! Jettisoned them into the black hole. The momentum caused by the launch has successfully propelled the station away from the singularity.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[Target.GetName]§!上的人员拆除了空间站的模块之后，将它们全部扔向黑洞。空间站和模块分离时产生的动量成功推动了空间站远离黑洞。

尽管拆卸抛弃空间站模块的决定为我们争取了更多时间，但是其产生的效果却远远小于我们的预期。这座空间站还是没能达到逃逸速度。
descriptions.en:
After stripping the station of its modules, the personnel aboard §Y[Target.GetName]§! Jettisoned them into the black hole. The momentum caused by the launch has successfully propelled the station away from the singularity.

While the decision to jettison the station modules has gained us more time, the results were less effected than expected. The station has not reached escape velocity.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[Target.GetName]§!已经太过靠近黑洞，它的推进器无法补偿剧烈增大的引力。

我们已经注定失去这座空间站了。如今我们能做的事只有延缓它终结的到来。
descriptions.en:
§Y[Target.GetName]§! got too close to the black hole, and its thrusters are unable to oppose the increased gravitational pull.

The station is lost. All we can do now is delay the inevitable.

options.script: name = ACKNOWLEDGED

descriptions.zh:
§Y[Target.GetName]§!已经越过了黑洞的事件视界。由于时间膨胀效应，空间站的残影将会在它本身消失很长时间以后仍然留存，在我们的传感器数据上永远刻下它的痕迹。

除非我们迅速切断与空间站内[owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]的所有联系，否则对所有已知物理定律崩溃的直接可能会不可挽回地损害我们的集体意识。
descriptions.en:
§Y[Target.GetName]§! is crossing the black hole's event horizon. Due to the effects of time dilatation, its afterimage will persist long after the station itself is gone, a memory forever etched in our sensor data.

Unless we quickly sever all connection with the [owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] inside the station, the firsthand experience of the breakdown of all known laws of physics may irreparably damage our shared consciousness.

descriptions.zh:
警告：§Y[Target.GetName]§!已非常接近黑洞的事件视界。重力吸引：无法逃脱。时间膨胀：剧增。建议执行行动：空间站内残存子个体自毁，以避免直接遭受已知物理定律的崩溃。

§R严重警告：§!若继续维持神经链接，我们的集体意识将遭受无法修复的损伤。
descriptions.en:
Warning: §Y[Target.GetName]§! dangerously close to event horizon. Gravity pull: inescapable. Time dilatation: increasing. Recommended course of action: self-termination of all drones residing inside the station to avoid the collective experience of the breakdown of all known laws of physics.

§RSevere warning:§! chance of irreparable damage to our collective consciousness if the neural link is maintained.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[Target.GetName]§!已经越过了黑洞的事件视界。由于时间膨胀效应，空间站的残影将会在它本身消失很长时间以后仍然留存，在我们的传感器数据上永远刻下它的痕迹。

即使光线也无法穿过黑洞的内轨道，空间站及其乘员的最后时刻将永远未知。
descriptions.en:
§Y[Target.GetName]§! is crossing the black hole's event horizon. Due to the effects of time dilatation, its afterimage will persist long after the station itself is gone, a memory forever etched in our sensor data.

Not even light can cross the inner orbit of a black hole: the final moments of the station and its personnel will forever remain unknown.

descriptions.zh:
意识膨胀。感知减慢如虫蠕。每个姿态都是一个无限的事件序列。我们正在见证无限——不，沐浴在其中。
就好像时间本身在屏住呼吸。

由于黑洞扭曲了时空织构，我们意识中的一部分凝固在永远的自由落体中。

我们被囚禁在黑洞中的一部分感知到的一日事实上外部将会过去数个世纪。我们可以利用这点。我们通过切换自身意识，可以通过一个全新的视角分析自己的整个历史，获得新的思维模式。

进这一次，分离使我们强大。从今往后，我们既是自己故事的主角，同时也是读者——我们将为自己书写一个壮丽的结局。
descriptions.en:
Thoughts dilate. Perception slows to a crawl. Every gesture is an infinite sequence of events. We are witnessing infinity - no, bathing in it.
It's as if time itself is holding its breath.

As the black hole distorts the fabric of spacetime, a fragment of our consciousness is now stuck in eternal freefall.

Centuries will pass while the fragment of ourself stuck within the black hole-self thinks for a day. We can exploit this. By shifting our self, we can now analyze our entire history from a new perspective. In this way, new patterns emerge.

For once, separation has made us stronger. From now on, we are both protagonists and readers of our own story - and we'll write ourselves a magnificent ending.

descriptions.zh:
状态报告：由于与黑洞的距离越来越近，我们在空间站内的无人机正在经历极端的时间膨胀。处理器速度降低。机械速度下降。内部日期系统溢出。

结论：该局势可以被利用。该空间站中的无人机可以一日的感知读过外部数个世纪。通过将感知能力重定向至此，我们可以对我们整个帝国的历史获得全新的观察视角。所有不良的处理模式都可以被修正。我们有能力优化自己的历史。

观测：仅此一次，分离使我们强大。
descriptions.en:
Status report: our drones inside the stations are experiencing extreme time dilation due to increased proximity with the black hole. Processor speed decreased. Mechanical speed decreased. Internal date systems overflowing.

Conclusion: this situation can be exploited. Centuries will pass while the drones on the station experience a single day. By redirecting cognitive power to them, we can gain a new perspective on the history of our empire. Any harmful patterns that emerge can be corrected. We can optimize our own future.

Observation: for once, separation has made us stronger.

descriptions.zh:
意识膨胀。感知减慢如虫蠕。每个姿态都是一个无限的事件序列。我们正在见证无限——不，沐浴在其中。
就好像时间本身在屏住呼吸。

由于黑洞扭曲了时空织构，我们意识中的一部分凝固在永远的自由落体中。

这感觉太痛苦了。我们的整个意识困于恒久的、永远落后一步的既视感中。正在尝试切断与[owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]的连接，但该过程需要无限长的时间才能生效。

我们学到了不少东西，但是代价是什么呢？

It's as if time itself is holding its breath.

As the black hole distorts the fabric of spacetime, a fragment of our consciousness is now stuck in eternal freefall.

It's excruciating. A perennial sense of deja-vu, of forever being a step behind. We are trying to sever connection with the [owner.GetIndividualNamePlural], but it will take an infinite amount of time for the process to take effect.

We have learned much. But at what cost?

状况报告：遭受认知创伤。无法应对黑洞内时间膨胀。
尝试切断与无人机链接。预计完成时间：43504967826056783年。

结论：维持链接的决定具有一定启发性，但同时极具破坏性。在任何情况下均不可再重蹈覆辙。
descriptions.en:
Status report: our drones inside the stations are experiencing extreme time dilation due to increased proximity with the black hole. Processor speed decreased. Mechanical speed decreased. Internal date systems overflowing.

Status report: suffering cognitive trauma. Unable to cope with the time dilatation within the black hole.
Attempting to sever connection with the drones. Estimated completion date: 43504967826056783 years.

Conclusion: our decision to maintain connection was instructive but ultimately harmful. Do not repeat under any circumstance.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[Target.GetName]§!逃离了黑洞的引力束缚，回归了围绕这颗坍缩恒星的稳定轨道。

在这一危险的过程中获得的数据可以让我们的[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]忙活上好几年。
descriptions.en:
§Y[Target.GetName]§! escaped the gravitational pull of the black hole, returning to a stable orbit around the collapsed star.

The data we gathered during this dangerous situation will keep our [Root.Owner.GetResearchers] busy for years.

descriptions.zh:

尽管许多人说这场经历简直“令人极度痛苦”，但空间站上的一位[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]则受到这次历险的启发，现在热切期望与其他的科学家分享新的洞见，就是也许有点太过热切了。
descriptions.en:
§Y[Target.GetName]§! escaped the gravitational pull of the black hole, returning to a stable orbit around the collapsed star.

 Through many have described the experience as 'utterly traumatizing', one of the [Root.Owner.GetResearchers] aboard the station was inspired by the ordeal, and is now eager - almost too eager - to share their new expertise with the rest of our scientific team.

优先事项：使用防辐射技术以保护无人机部件，以对抗辐射。

The resulting software damage risks spreading to our Core intelligence, with potentially devastating consequences for our whole empire.

Our [Root.owner.GetScientistPlural] estimate the star will return to a normal level of activity within §Hfive years§!.

先导性分析表明，沉迷于活体陈设将对他们的自我价值感产生积极影响，但也可能使他们面临无法预料的危险。
descriptions.en:
Warning: bio-trophies are displaying anomalous behavior. While most expressed annoyance at the reduced capacities of their mechanical servitors, a small percentage are now helping their servitors execute routine tasks, citing "pity" and "sympathy" as motivation for their actions. They're now calling for the institution of a "care home" to watch over their malfunctioning caretakers.

Pre-emptive analysis suggests indulging the bio-trophies will have a positive impact on their sense of self-worth, but may also expose them to unforeseen dangers.

descriptions.en:
Status report: radiation levels on §Y[Target.GetName]§! are now stable. §Y[Target.GetStarName]§! has returned to normal levels of solar activity. The geomagnetic storm has ended.

Final report: we struggled to deal with the storm, and failed to protect our drones from radiation damage. While we were able to survive the challenge, we see room for improvement.

descriptions.zh:
状态报告：§Y[Target.GetName]§!上的辐射水平已经趋于稳定。§Y[Target.GetStarName]§!已恢复到正常的恒星活动水平。地磁风暴已经结束。

最终报告：我们仍在遭受辐射损伤的后续影响。还需要一定时间恢复到理想的认知状态。令人不满的结果。我们在未来必须多家准备。
descriptions.en:
Status report: radiation levels on §Y[Target.GetName]§! are now stable. §Y[Target.GetStarName]§! has returned to normal levels of solar activity. The geomagnetic storm has ended.

Final report: we are still suffering from long-lasting consequences of radiation damage. Returning to an optimal cognitive state will require time. Unsatisfying outcome. We must be better prepared for the future.

descriptions.zh: 信息：尽管我们不再需要生物助手的服务，但我们的活体人口已经变得非常适应这一角色。他们似乎很享受承担责任的机会。如何继续？
descriptions.en: Information: while the services of our Bio-Assistants are no longer required, our bio-pops have grown rather attached to their role. It seems they relish the chance to hold responsibility. How to proceed?

label.en: Let the Bio-Assistants keep their playground.

descriptions.zh:
我们的人民从轨道上看到的是§H[capital_scope.GetName]§!突然关停，城市内的每个光源都被熄灭。而§H[capital_scope.GetName]§!的居民所经历的更糟糕：车辆变成了路障，工厂停止运转，医院设备处于无响应的状态。这是一次全球性的突然停电，突如其来，莫名其妙。

当寂静和阴影笼罩着我们的星球时，奇怪的光芒在天空中绽放，将我们的首都恒星系包围在万华镜般的迷雾中。这两个事件无疑是相关的，但我们的[root.GetTechnicianPlural]仍然在抓瞎——是的，字面意义上的抓瞎。
descriptions.en:
What our people saw from orbit was §H[capital_scope.GetName]§! shutting down, every light source within the city snuffed out at once. What people on §H[capital_scope.GetName]§! experienced was much worse: vehicles reduced to road blocks, factories grinding to a halt, hospital equipment lifeless and inert. A world-wide blackout, as sudden as it was inexplicable.

As silence and shadows veiled our world, strange light patterns bloomed in the sky, enveloping our capital system in a kaleidoscopic mist. The two events are doubtlessly related, but our [root.GetTechnicianPlural] are still - literally - in the dark.

descriptions.zh: 我们的传感器报告万华镜寄生虫发光图样的幻影出现在了§H[kaleidoscope_system.GetName]§!恒星系。这个现象的自然机理暂时还不清楚。
descriptions.en: Our sensors report the apparition of kaleidoscopic light patterns in the §H[kaleidoscope_system.GetName]§! system. The nature of the phenomenon is unclear.

descriptions.zh: 我们先前观察到的万华镜幻影已经移动到了§H[kaleidoscope_system.GetName]§!恒星系。
descriptions.en: The kaleidoscopic apparition we previously observed has moved to the §H[kaleidoscope_system.GetName]§! system.

options.script: name = CURIOUS

descriptions.zh:
我们在自己的电网系统中找不到任何缺陷。我们的发电机正在产生能量，但是某种存在……某种存在正在吸收它。这可能是我们在天空中能够观察到光图案的结果，这个图案的几何性质透露出一定的智慧痕迹。

这个东西——这个活着的§Y万华镜§!——是一个满怀恶意的存在，还是一团无意识的迷雾？答案尚未明确。
descriptions.en:
We can find no defects in our power grid. Our generators are producing energy, but something is... absorbing it. It may be a result of the light patterns witnessed in our skies, the geometric nature of which betray an intelligent design.

Is this thing - this living §YKaleidoscope§! - a malicious entity, or just a mindless mist? The answer is unclear.

label.zh: 试图将它从我们的电网中剥离出来。
label.en: Attempt to detach it from our power grid.

options.script: name = situation.2005.a

descriptions.zh:
多亏了我们的[owner.GetTechnicianPlural]和[owner.GetScientistPlural]的通力合作，我们设法将能量寄生虫从我们的电力网络中剔除了。我们最漫长的黑夜已经过去，但是§Y万华镜§!寄生虫仍然在我们的头顶上闪耀，渴望能量。

我们无法与它进行交流，常规武器对这类生物无效。我们剩下的选项是给它提供足够的能量以维持其心情满足，或者试图让它挨饿。我们的特工还建议组织一次§Y谍报行动§!，将它引诱到另一个帝国。让其他人来处理它。
descriptions.en:
Thanks to the coordinated effort of our [owner.GetTechnicianPlural] and [owner.GetScientistPlural], the energy parasite has been cut from our power grid. Our longest night is over, but §Ythe Kaleidoscope§! still shines upon us, hungry for energy.

We have no way to communicate with it, and conventional weaponry won't work on a being of this kind. Our remaining options are to feed it just enough to keep it appeased, or try to starve it. Our operatives also suggested organizing an §YEspionage Operation§! to lure it towards another empire. Let someone else deal with it.

descriptions.zh:
我们的人民从轨道上看到的是一个熟悉的图案再次出现：§H[capital_scope.GetName]§!上的所有电源突然关闭，我们的首都受到全球停电的打击，而熹微的光亮在天空中跃动。
§Y万华镜§!回来了！我们曾经将这个能量寄生虫诱骗到其他国家，现在又给送了回来。

根据我们专家的分析，投资建设一个§Y行星护盾生成器§!能够防止我们的首都再次成为目标，但是一切都为时已晚：因为能量寄生虫已经待这儿不走了。
descriptions.en:
What our people saw from orbit was the repetition of a familiar pattern: all power on §H[capital_scope.GetName]§! shutting down, our capital hit by a worldwide blackout while shimmering lights danced in the sky.
§YThe Kaleidoscope§! has returned! The energy parasite we once foisted onto others has been sent back to us.

According to our experts, investing in a §YPlanetary Shield Generator§! will prevent our capital from being targeted again, but it's too late for now: the energy parasite is here to stay.

label.zh: 这个非自然的野兽别想在我们的恒星系容身！
label.en: The unnatural monster has no space in our system!

tooltips.zh: 解锁谍报行动§Y引诱万华镜寄生虫§!
tooltips.en: Unlocks Espionage Operation §YLure the Kaleidoscope§!

label.zh: 我们必须和这个奇迹之兽交好！
label.en: We must befriend this wondrous creature!

tooltips.zh: 解锁谍报行动§Y引诱万华镜寄生虫§!
tooltips.en: Unlocks Espionage Operation §YLure the Kaleidoscope§!

label.en: It wants energy? Let it choke on it.

tooltips.zh: 解锁谍报行动§Y引诱万华镜寄生虫§!
tooltips.en: Unlocks Espionage Operation §YLure the Kaleidoscope§!

descriptions.zh: 依照我们经过验证和测试的流程，我们将万华镜寄生虫从§H[root.GetName]§!的能量电网中剥离，恢复了首都的供电。
descriptions.en: Following our proven and tested procedures, we detached the Kaleidoscope from §H[root.GetName]§!'s energy grid, restoring power to our capital.

descriptions.zh: 我们的特工通过假扮成技工成功渗透进入了§H[target.GetName]§!的能源区划。他们的下一项任务是安装一个返航信标，诱惑能量寄生虫前来这个行星。
descriptions.en: By posing as technicians, our operatives successfully infiltrated the §H[target.GetName]§!'s energy districts. Their next assignment is to install a homing beacon to lure the energy parasite to the planet.

options.script: name = ACKNOWLEDGED

descriptions.zh:
我们天空中的异光消散了，提前宣告了我们的特工之后汇报的事情：他们激活了能量信标，将§Y万华镜§!寄生虫引走了！

现在就让§H[target.GetName]§!去处理这麻烦吧。
descriptions.en:
The lights have faded from our skies, first announcing what our intelligence operatives later confirmed: our operators activated the energy beacon, luring §Ythe Kaleidoscope§! away!

Let the §H[target.GetName]§! deal with it now.

descriptions.zh: 依据我们的谍报信息，§H[kaleidoscope_new_owner.GetName]§!，目前正遭遭受到能源短缺的困扰。我们送他们的§Y万华镜§!似乎正是这一经济困境的主要起因。
descriptions.en: According to our espionage reports, §H[kaleidoscope_new_owner.GetName]§!, is currently suffering from an energy shortage. The §YKaleidoscope§! we gifted them seems to be the main cause of their economic troubles.

options.script: name = SPLENDID

descriptions.zh: 一只饥肠辘辘的万华镜寄生虫将双齿深深扎进了§H[event_target:infested_planet.GetName]§!的能量电网中。随之而来的全殖民地范围的大停电颇为剧烈，但与此前的攻击并不相似。我们已经知道怎么对付这东西了。
descriptions.en: A starved Kaleidoscope has sunk its metaphorical teeth into §H[event_target:infested_planet.GetName]§!'s energy grid. The ensuing colony-wide blackout was dramatic, but not dissimilar from previous attacks. We know how to deal with this.

descriptions.zh: 一只贪婪的万华镜正试图强行连接到我们在§H[target.GetName]§!上的§Y能量中枢§!。这提供了一个研究这只生物独特能力的绝佳机会，但我们预计这座建筑将因此受到严重破坏。
descriptions.en: A ravenous Kaleidoscope is trying to forcibly connect itself to one our §YEnergy Nexus§! on §H[target.GetName]§!. This presents a remarkable opportunity to study the being's unique abilities, but we expect the building will be severely damaged as a result.

label.zh: 就让它吃点我们的能量吧。为了科学！
label.en: Let it eat our energy. For Science!

descriptions.zh: 万华镜焦躁地颤动着，让我们的天空充满了不和谐、不均匀的光线。我们的人不禁觉得这种景象令人不安。
descriptions.en: The Kaleidoscope trembles nervously, filling our skies with jarring, uneven patterns of light. Our people can't help but find the spectacle unnerving.

descriptions.zh: 万华镜犹如一道敞开的窗口，让我们的天空充满了不祥而病态的图案。我们的祭祀认为这是凶兆。也许明智的做法是牺牲一些能量给这个生物，消除它的饥饿，平息我们人民的恐惧。
descriptions.en: The Kaleidoscope throbs like an open wound, filling our skies with ominous, sickly patterns. Our priests believe it an ill omen. It may be wise to sacrifice some energy to the creature, to quench its hunger and appease our people's fears.

label.en: We shall not bend to its will.

descriptions.zh: 万华镜号渴求能量，它学会了如何从我们的舰队中吸取能量。尽管能量消耗很小，但对我们的航速有明显的影响。
descriptions.en: Hungry for energy, the Kaleidoscope has learned how to siphon energy from our fleet. The power drain is minimal, but is having a detectable impact on our ships' speed.

descriptions.zh:
开心的万华镜让[owner.capital_scope.GetName]的天空中涂满了令人愉悦的图形，一个个分型互相流变，带来了一波波变化万千的奇观。

整颗星球仿佛静止了。人们驻足欣赏，为之惊叹。
descriptions.en:
A happy Kaleidoscope fills [owner.capital_scope.GetName]'s skies with pleasing shapes, fractals melting into other fractals in ever-changing waves of wonder.

The planet stops. Admires. Breathes.

descriptions.zh: 万华镜不断变化的图案会不会是一种沟通的方式？或者这只是一种类似呼吸一般的自发流程？我们的[root.GetScientistPlural]尚未找到答案。万华镜也正在为我们带来不可估量的研究数据。
descriptions.en: Could the shifting patterns of the Kaleidoscope be a form of communication? Or are they an autonomous process, more akin to breathing? Our [root.GetScientistPlural] still don't have an answer. The Kaleidoscope is providing us with an invaluable amount of scientific data.

descriptions.zh:
在在最后一阵红色的起伏图案爆发之后，万华镜消失了，它的彩色卷须像雾一样消散了。

在它的光芒下度过了这么长时间后，我们的天空看起来空落落的。
descriptions.en:
After a final burst of red, undulating patterns, the Kaleidoscope faded away, its colorful tendrils dissipating like mist.

After so much time spent beneath its lights, our skies look almost empty.

options.script: name = ACKNOWLEDGED

descriptions.zh: 传感器回报我们在[kaleidoscope_system.GetName]恒星系探测到的万华镜图案已经消退了。
descriptions.en: Sensors report the kaleidoscopic pattern we detected in the [kaleidoscope_system.GetName] system has faded away.

options.script: name = CURIOUS

descriptions.zh:
我们有幸得出体验星系最壮观的灯光秀：万华镜的花瓣往复折叠、盛开、绽放！然而，我们的仪器则带来了一则不那么令人高兴的消息。

这种能量生物变得如此充满力量，它甚至像一颗垂死的恒星一样发生了坍缩。在它的废墟中，我们的探测器发现了一个外形非常类似花朵的晶体团簇。根据初步研究，这种“花”可以放大最微弱的光线，在这个过程中打破了一些已知的物理定律。我们的[root.owner.GetScientistPlural]推测，这种花不过是一座光线可以被无限地反射叠加的多维镜屋中可见的冰山一角。
descriptions.en:
We have been blessed to experience the galaxy's most splendid light show: kaleidoscopic petals folding into themselves; blooming; exploding! However, our instruments tell a less triumphant story.

The energy being became so full of power it collapsed into itself like a dying star. From the devastation, our probes retrieved a crystalline cluster, shaped very much like a flower blossom. According to preliminary studies, the 'flower' can magnify the intensity of the faintest light ray, breaking a few known laws of physics in the process. Our [root.owner.GetScientistPlural] hypothesize the flower is merely the visible part of a larger construct - a multi-dimensional house of mirrors where light beams are infinitely reflected and recombined.

descriptions.zh: 传感器报告§H[kaleidoscope_system.GetName]§!恒星系中万华镜的图案发生了剧烈的绽放，并在五彩斑斓的爆炸中消失了。那场面一定相当壮观。
descriptions.en: Sensors report the kaleidoscopic pattern in the §H[kaleidoscope_system.GetName]§! system just bloomed, disappearing in a final burst of colorful patterns. Must have been quite the spectacle.

options.script: name = CURIOUS

descriptions.zh:
万华镜自我折叠的一瞬，它看起来就像一朵最精致的水晶花。然而，随之而来的爆炸一点也不温和：一股灼热的爆炸席卷了整个星系，我们所有的电子设备都发生了过载，烧焦了能源电网。

维修工作已经在进行中，但我们还需要一段时间才能适应这片空旷的天空。
descriptions.en:
When the Kaleidoscope folded into itself, just for a second, it looked like the most delicate crystalline flower. However, the ensuing explosion was anything but gentle: a coruscating boom that scorched the system and overloaded all our electronic devices, frying our energy grid.

Repairs are already underway, but it will take some time for us to get used to the newly empty sky.

options.script: name = UNFORTUNATE

descriptions.zh: 传感器报告在§H[kaleidoscope_system.GetName]§!恒星系的万华镜图案爆炸了，释放了一道能量冲击波损坏了星系中所有的设施。
descriptions.en: Sensors report the kaleidoscopic pattern in the §H[kaleidoscope_system.GetName]§! system just exploded, releasing an energy shockwave that doubtlessly damaged every structure in the system.

options.script: name = CURIOUS

descriptions.zh: 万华镜寄生虫事实证明是一个异常好相处的邻居，但是要让它持续保持满足的心态不是一件容易的事情。建一个戴森球能不能满足它对能量的那种无底洞般的胃口呢？
descriptions.en: The Kaleidoscope has proven to be a strangely amiable neighbor, but keeping it sated has proven to be a challenge. Would a Dyson Sphere quench its endless thirst for energy?

label.zh: 为万华镜寄生虫提供一个改版戴森球。
label.en: Modify a Dyson Sphere for the Kaleidoscope.

tooltips.zh: 解锁一项新的戴森球升级。
tooltips.en: Unlock a new Dyson Sphere upgrade.

options.script: name = situation.2048.b

descriptions.zh:
万华镜寄生虫盘附在了我们提供的改版戴森球上，吞食着一整个恒星的能量，其不断延展的、色彩缤纷的花瓣包覆了整个恒星系。根据我们的数据，这个噬能生命体现在处于一种恒定的、可控的超载状态，在一个类似于死亡和重生的无尽循环中，不断地长出新芽，再不断地爆裂。

我们不知道这个生命体是否有思考能力，但我们希望它的存在本身现在和它产生的光图案一样令人愉快。
descriptions.en:
The Kaleidoscope has latched onto the modified Dyson Sphere we provided, consuming the energy of a star and extending its colorful petals to encompass the whole system. According to our data, the energy being is now in a state of constant, controlled overload, perpetually growing new buds and bursting in an endless cycle akin to death and rebirth.

We do not know if the being is capable of thought, but we hope its existence is now as pleasant as the patterns of light it produces.

descriptions.zh:
这一天终于来临。我们的[Owner.GetSensoryWorkers]已经就位，准备为我们对§Y[This.GetTrophyName]§!进行全面的探索。随着研究的开始，我们将一小部分意识集中在§Y[Target.GetName]§!上，以消化吸收对异常项目的研究。然而，让我们将残余物拖到[Target.GetPlanetHabitat]以后发现，结果并不如我们希望的那么有趣。

就在这项进程开始之后不久，我们决定将研究转移到位于[Target.GetName]的中央团簇，由特化的[Owner.GetSensoryWorkers]对其进行持续观测。希望能从中有更多的发现。
descriptions.en:
The day has arrived. Our [Owner.GetSensoryWorkers] were in place and ready to give us a thorough exploration of the §Y[This.GetTrophyName]§!. As the study, began a small portion of our consciousness focused on §Y[Target.GetName]§! to absorb the study of the anomalous item. However, the revelations were not as interesting as we had hoped as we dragged the remains to the [Target.GetPlanetHabitat].

Shortly after the process began, we decided to move the study to the center of our cluster on [Target.GetName], where the specialized [Owner.GetSensoryWorkers] will continuously observe it. Hopefully something more will come of it.

descriptions.zh:
这一天终于来临。我们的[Owner.GetSensoryWorkers]已经就位，准备为我们对§Y[This.GetTrophyName]§!进行全面的探索。随着研究的开始，我们将一小部分意识集中在§Y[Target.GetName]§!上，以消化吸收对异常项目的研究。当天，整个[Owner.GetName]的产出率整整降低了§H0.2%§!。

探测数据被深深映在我们的意识当中，并转移到到位于[Target.GetName]的中央团簇，由特化的[Owner.GetSensoryWorkers]对其进行持续观测。
descriptions.en:
The day has arrived. Our [Owner.GetSensoryWorkers] were in place and ready to give us a thorough exploration of the §Y[This.GetTrophyName]§!. As the study began, a significant portion of our consciousness focused on §Y[Target.GetName]§! to absorb the import of this anomalous item. Productivity in the [Owner.GetName] was reduced by a whole §H0.2%§! for the day.

The sensory data was then archived deep in our consciousness before being placed in the center of our cluster on [Target.GetName], where the specialized [Owner.GetSensoryWorkers] will continuously observe it.

descriptions.zh:
这一天终于来临。大量[Owner.GetSensoryWorkers]已经就位，准备为我们对§Y[This.GetTrophyName]§!进行切实的探索。随着研究的开始，我们将整个意识集中在§Y[Target.GetName]§!上，以消化吸收对这一令我们全神贯注的异常项目的研究。几个危险境地的[owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]因一时分神而受伤，甚至还有几个失踪了。我们对此无比痴迷。

在初步研究完成后，我们决定将其转移到到位于[Target.GetName]的中央团簇，由特化的[Owner.GetSensoryWorkers]对其进行持续观测。我们近乎虔诚地部署了这一研究任务，并持续分配一部分意识对其进行观测。
descriptions.en:
The day has arrived. A massive amount of [Owner.GetSensoryWorkers] were in place and ready to give us an exacting exploration of the §Y[This.GetTrophyName]§!. As the study began, for a moment, our entire consciousness focused on §Y[Target.GetName]§! to absorb the study of the anomalous item which preoccupied us so. Several [owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] caught up in precarious situations were injured in the momentary distraction, and a few were even lost. So great was our fascination.

After the initial study was complete, we decided to move it to the center of our cluster on [Target.GetName], where the specialized [Owner.GetSensoryWorkers] will continuously observe it. We placed it down, almost reverently, and continue to dedicate a part of our consciousness to the observation.

label.zh: 在[This.GetTrophyName]中，我们重新认识了自己。
label.en: In the [This.GetTrophyName], we have found ourselves.

descriptions.zh:
今天，§Y[Target.GetName]§!首都的人群们迎来了阴沉的一天。游行的队伍携带着我们摧毁§Y[This.GetLeviathanTargetName]§!的证明，漫步经过叽叽喳喳的围观者。这一过程在全帝国范围内广播，但反响极低，[This.GetTrophyName]似乎没有我们预想的那么令人感兴趣。

在完成了环球展览之后，[This.GetTrophyName]被放在了首都中心进行特展，以激励我们以及子孙后代。
descriptions.en:
An overcast day greeted the middling crowd on §Y[Target.GetName]'s§! capital city today. The procession carrying our proof of the destruction of the §Y[This.GetLeviathanTargetName]§! ambled past the meandering onlookers. Its progress was broadcast throughout our empire, but engagement was low as the [This.GetTrophyName] did not seem to be quite as enticing as we had hoped.

After finishing the world tour, the [This.GetTrophyName] was placed in a specialized display at the center of the capital to inspire generations to come.

descriptions.zh:
今天，§Y[Target.GetName]§!首都的拥挤人群们迎来了阳光明媚的一天。游行的队伍携带着我们摧毁§Y[This.GetLeviathanTargetName]§!的证明，四处环游逐一展览。游行的过程在全帝国范围内数十亿观众直播。[This.GetTrophyName]一时成为了[Owner.Species.GetAdj]文化的重要象征，激发着全[Owner.GetName]的艺术家和发明家们。

在完成了环球展览之后，[This.GetTrophyName]被放在了首都中心进行特展，以激励我们以及子孙后代。
descriptions.en:
A bright day greeted the packed crowds on §Y[Target.GetName]§! today as the procession carrying our proof of the destruction of the §Y[This.GetLeviathanTargetName]§! traveled around. The parade's progress was broadcast throughout our empire to billions of viewers. The [This.GetTrophyName] already seems to have become a staple of [Owner.Species.GetAdj] culture, inspiring artists and creators across [Owner.GetName].

After finishing the world tour, the [This.GetTrophyName] was placed in a specialized display at the center of the capital to inspire generations to come.

descriptions.zh: 今天，§Y[Target.GetName]§!晴空万里令人心旷神怡，不过这是理所当然的，因为我们把大气调控系统已经满负荷开到爆了。在这伟大的一天，[Target.GetPlanetHabitat]上的每座城市的大街小巷都挤得满满当当，而更多的商旅飞船仍在不断地停泊进行星的轨道。盛大的游行逐一经过每一个定居点，迎接他们的是人山人海的街道和[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]们热情的欢呼。我们帝国中每一座能够进行大型全息投影的城市也都挤满了观看盛大全息转播的观众。作为典礼的重中之重，[This.GetTrophyName]抵达了[Target.GetName]的首都，人们已经讨论起了将今天定为每年的§Y[This.GetLeviathanTargetName]§!节日。在完成了环球展览之后，[This.GetTrophyName]被放在了首都中心进行特展，以激励我们以及子孙后代。
descriptions.en: The weather on §Y[Target.GetName]§! was unnaturally great today, as it should have been, considering we ran our atmosphere control system on overdrive. Every city on the [Target.GetPlanetHabitat] reached its capacity, and there were still tourist ships orbiting the world just to be a part of this great day. The grand parade traveled through each settlement in turn, and was greeted by streets packed with [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Every city capable of requisitioning a holo-display in our empire was also overflowing with spectators for the grand hologram rebroadcasts. As the centerpiece of the parade, the [This.GetTrophyName], reached [Target.GetName]'s capital, people were already talking about making today a yearly §Y[This.GetLeviathanTargetName]§! inspired holiday. The [This.GetTrophyName] was then placed in a specialized display at the center of the capital to inspire generations to come.

label.zh: 又没人来看嚷嚷着办什么庆典啊？
label.en: If they won't to show up for it, why did they ask for a celebration?
Today was a good day for all [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
We stand united today, as one.

descriptions.zh: 为了准备那个重要的日子，我们将一颗§Y以太巨龙的獠牙§!转运到§Y[Target.GetName]§!。把它们塞进货运飞船是一项极富挑战的工作，以太巨龙独特的生理构造似乎违背了物理法则。在进入[Target.GetPlanetHabitat]大气层时，獠牙对飞船发生了极其奇怪的反应：它在众目睽睽之下开始瓦解，要不是飞船快速应对，我们可能就会失去这一宝贵的物品。
descriptions.en: In preparation for the big day, we have transferred one of the §YEther Drake's Fangs§! to §Y[Target.GetName]§!. Getting them into the transport ship was a challenge, as the Ether Drake's unique biology does not seem to follow the laws of physics. The fang reacted particularly strangely to the transport ship entering the [Target.GetPlanetHabitat]'s atmosphere: it began unraveling before us, and if the transport ship hadn't responded quickly, we might have lost the coveted artifact.

label.zh: 建造一个更好的容器，把獠牙带下来。
label.en: Construct a better container and bring the fang down.

label.zh: 这奇怪的反应可比[Owner.GetParadeStudy]好玩多了。
label.en: This reaction is much more interesting than any [Owner.GetParadeStudy].

tooltips.zh: 取消[Owner.GetParadeStudy]以展开对反应的研究。
tooltips.en: Cancel the [Owner.GetParadeStudy] in favor of studying the reaction.

label.en: Replace the fang with a replica.

tooltips.zh: 这将会降低该机遇产出的凝聚力。
tooltips.en: This will reduce the amount of unity the opportunity will produce.

descriptions.zh:
摘取§Y裂爪龙之眼§!是一项混乱不堪的工程，开始阶段错误百出。幸运的是，这只巨兽有许多只眼睛让我们逐一试错。我们将这只眼睛拖到了[Target.Solar_System.GetName]以后发生一件又奇妙又恶心的事情：这只眼睛迅速地黏住了当地的传感阵列，并将自己牢牢地嵌在上面，俯视着§Y[Target.GetName]§!。事件的起因还在调查当中，但需要重申，这只巨龙的许多生理学知识仍是我们未知的。

眼睛还没有和恒星基地完全融为一体，但我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]认为如果我们想继续进行之前的计划，就必须阻止这个状况。
descriptions.en:
The extraction of the §YShard's Eye§! was a messy process with a few false starts. Luckily, the behemoth had a lot of eyes for us to practice on. We then towed the optic to [Target.Solar_System.GetName], and something both fascinating and revolting happened: the oculus started attaching and integrating itself into the local sensor array overlooking §Y[Target.GetName]§!. The cause of this is unknown, but then again, much of the Drake's physiology is beyond us.

The fusing is not complete yet, but our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] believe it has to be halted now if we wish to proceed with our previous plans.

label.zh: 让我们用裂爪龙之眼审视世界吧。
label.en: Let us see with the sight of The Shard!

tooltips.zh: 取消[Owner.GetParadeStudy]以把这只眼睛用于其他用途。
tooltips.en: Cancel the [Owner.GetParadeStudy] in favor of using the eye for a different purpose.

label.zh: 快把它抠下来，最后期限要到了！
label.en: Scrape it off, we have deadlines to reach.

tooltips.zh: 这将会降低该机遇产出的凝聚力。
tooltips.en: This will reduce the amount of unity the opportunity will produce.

label.zh: 小心地把它取下来，我们可不想有什么磕碰。
label.en: Very carefully remove it, we wouldn't want to damage it.

descriptions.zh:
§Y无畏战舰反应堆§!在运抵§Y[Target.GetName]§!之前一直是一个超级乖乖的货物，抵达后我们将其安置在一处仓库内以待那一天的到来。这下问题就来了：在无人照看的情况下，这台反应堆突然自己重启了。反应堆迸射出巨大的等离子电弧，整座仓库由内而外发出耀眼的光，整座建筑似乎很快就要被熔化了。

我们[Owner.GetScientistPlural]反应迅速，力挽狂澜，于是现在我们就有了一台运转中的反应堆了。
descriptions.en:
The §YDreadnought's Reactor§! was a very well-behaved cargo until it arrived at §Y[Target.GetName]§!, where we placed it in a warehouse awaiting its big day. It was there the troubles began: while no one was looking, the reactor restarted itself. The warehouse was lit up from within as it spouted out huge arcs of plasma, threatening to melt down the entire building.

The quick actions of our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] were just sufficient to save it in the nick of time, with the upshot that we now have an active reactor to do with as we please.

label.en: Attach it to the [Target.GetPlanetHabitat]'s power grid.

tooltips.zh: 这将会提升该机遇产出的凝聚力。
tooltips.en: This will increase the amount of unity the opportunity will produce.

descriptions.zh: 即便我们预警了外星污染的危险，但还是有东西搞砸了。§Y族母的鞭毛§!运入§Y[Target.GetName]§!首都时，它以某种方式接触了其中一个管运者，然后几乎是瞬间，它就发生了变化。这件战利品上长出了脉动的附肢，变成了一团搅动的肉质。慢慢地它逐渐细化，然后竟然长成了那个被接触的管运者的模样！似乎是族母的再生能力接纳了我们物种的基因，并开始产出更多的[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
descriptions.en: Even with our xeno-contamination precautions, something went wrong. As the §YMatriarch's Flagella§! entered §Y[Target.GetName]'s§! capital, it somehow got in contact with one of the handlers, and instantly, the flagella started reacting. Pulsating ripping appendages began growing from the Trophy, first forming an indistinct churning mass of flesh. Over time it became more detailed, and to our surprise, it assumed the shape of the unfortunate handler! It seems like the regenerative powers of the Matriarch have accepted the DNA of our kind and are now in the process of generating more [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

label.zh: 让围观者也一起尝尝这个！
label.en: Use this to feed the onlookers!

tooltips.zh: 这将会提升该机遇产出的凝聚力。
tooltips.en: This will increase the amount of unity the opportunity will produce.

label.en: Let the reaction run its course.

tooltips.zh: 这将会降低该机遇产出的凝聚力。
tooltips.en: This will reduce the amount of unity the opportunity will produce.

descriptions.zh: 将§Y天空龙羽翼§!带回家的时候，我们的货运飞船发现他们经过的超空间航道发生了二次扭曲。期限认为只是普通的异常现象而忽视了，直到飞船进入§Y[Target.Solar_System.GetName]§!时才发现，有一团追逐着飞船的实体导致了超空间航道膨胀：一窝龙的幼崽热切追逐着我们的货运飞船，从中鱼贯而出进入我们的星系。他们应该是躲藏在跳跃点附近跟随者我们出来航道的。这些小龙似乎没有它们亲代的智力，而是漫无目的地跟随着我们——确切地说是跟随着羽翼。
descriptions.en: While carrying home the §YSky Dragon's Plume§!, our transportation ship noticed that the hyperlane they traveled through had a second distortion beyond their ship. Initially disregarding this as just an anomaly, it was not apparent until the ship entered §Y[Target.Solar_System.GetName]§! that a group of pursuing entities was causing the hyperlane-dilation: a clutch of dragon whelps exited into our system in hot pursuit of our transport ship. They must have lain in hiding near the jump point and followed our exit. The dragonlings do not seem to possess the mental faculties of their progenitor and seem to be aimlessly following us or, more particularly, the plume.

tooltips.zh: 这将会提升该机遇产出的凝聚力。
tooltips.en: This will increase the amount of unity the opportunity will produce.

tooltips.zh: 这将会降低该机遇产出的凝聚力。
tooltips.en: This will reduce the amount of unity the opportunity will produce.

label.zh: 我们得在[Target.Solar_System.GetName]为他们设立一个栖息地。
label.en: We should set up a sanctuary for them in [Target.Solar_System.GetName].

tooltips.zh: 取消[Owner.GetParadeStudy]以开辟一颗小行星让幼崽居住。
tooltips.en: Cancel the [Owner.GetParadeStudy] in favor of giving an asteroid for the whelplings to inhabit.

label.zh: 我们的[Owner.GetParadeStudy]还迎来了一群活体成员该有多好！
label.en: Imagine having live subjects for the [Owner.GetParadeStudy]!

tooltips.zh: 这将会提升该机遇产出的凝聚力。
tooltips.en: This will increase the amount of unity the opportunity will produce.

label.zh: 警告性开火，把它们吓跑！
label.en: Fire some warning shots, drive them off!

descriptions.zh: 今天早晨，在§Y[Target.GetName]§!上有个惊喜等着我们，§Y拾荒机器人压缩机§!在我们的储存设施里吐出了最后一块它的作品。这一大块合金比我们所能想象所能产出的最致密的合金还要紧实，仅需数立方米就可以建造出一整艘战列舰。这一喜出望外的发展让我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]相信他们有希望让压缩机以§G0.001%§!的功率重新运作。
descriptions.en: This morning, a surprise awaited us on §Y[Target.GetName]§! as the §YScavenger Bot's Compactor§! deposited the last of its creations in our storage facility. The large chunk of alloys was denser and more compact than anything we could ever hope to produce, containing enough metals in a few cubic meters to build an entire battleship. This fantastic development has our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] believing that they can get the compactor working again at §G0.001%§! efficiency, if we should wish it.

label.zh: 把它拆了用来造点东西。
label.en: Break it apart and use it for construction.

tooltips.zh: 这将会提升该机遇产出的凝聚力。
tooltips.en: This will increase the amount of unity the opportunity will produce.

label.zh: 把压缩机丢回太空运转。
label.en: Return the Compactor to space and let it work.

tooltips.zh: 取消[Owner.GetParadeStudy]以重新激活压缩机，在[Target.GetName]的轨道上制造£alloys£ §Y+10§!矿藏。
tooltips.en: Cancel the [Owner.GetParadeStudy] in favor of reactivating the compactor and gaining a £alloys£ §Y+10§! deposit in orbit of [Target.GetName].

descriptions.zh:
§Y星际幽魂散发器囊§!这发出的斑驳光芒看起来格外引人注目，以至于让人差点没发现这个幽魂用来产生护盾的囊发生了泄露。在快速确认里面的化学物质不会导致§Y[Target.GetName]§!生态系统崩溃之后，我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]专注于分析这些气体对我们大气的影响。

似乎这些泄露的化学物质已经混入了我们大气的中间层，正在高效地散发其中凝聚的能量。如果我们继续散发其中的物质，它甚至可以有效地提高我们行星的防御能力。
descriptions.en:
The strobing lights of the §YStellar Wraith's Disperser Sack§! were distracting to look upon, so distracting that it took a while to detect that the sack the Wraith used to generate its natural shield was leaking. After quickly confirming that exposure to the chemicals inside would not cause a total ecological collapse on §Y[Target.GetName]§!, our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] focused on analyzing the effects the gas had on our atmosphere.

It seems like the emitted chemicals have fused with our mesosphere and disperse concentrated energies surprisingly well. So well that if we release the rest of the disperser's contents, there would be a noticeable increase in planetary defensiveness.

label.zh: 把里面的气体抽出来完成反应。
label.en: Extract the rest of the gas and let the reaction finish.

tooltips.zh: 取消[Owner.GetParadeStudy]以将[Target.GetName]的向大气灌输幽魂散布器囊。
tooltips.en: Cancel the [Owner.GetParadeStudy] in favor of infusing [Target.GetName]'s atmosphere with the Wraith's Disperser Sack.

options.script: name = situation.1075.b

tooltips.zh: 这将会提升该机遇产出的凝聚力。
tooltips.en: This will increase the amount of unity the opportunity will produce.

descriptions.zh: 我们的[Owner.GetTeamMemberPlural]向[Target.Solar_System.GetName]汇报了运输§Y恐怖负相物质§!的货运飞船上的奇怪的现象。我们被包括通向纯粹苦痛与毁灭低语的世界窗口之类的恼人的幻想所袭扰。据信原因就是[This.GetLeviathanTargetName]的团块，我们有理由担忧如果将船上的这玩意带到§Y[Target.GetName]§!到底会发生什么。
descriptions.en: Our [Owner.GetTeamMemberPlural] have been reporting strange activity on the ship transporting the §YHorrific Inverse Mass§! to [Target.Solar_System.GetName]. Windows into worlds of pure pain and whispers of destruction are just a few of the disturbing accounts we have received. It's believed that the mass of the [This.GetLeviathanTargetName] is to blame, and we might rightfully worry what would happen if we were to bring the ship's cargo to §Y[Target.GetName]§!.

label.en: Return it to whence it came.

tooltips.zh: 取消[Owner.GetParadeStudy]以保护[Target.GetName]上[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的安全和精神健康。
tooltips.en: Cancel the [Owner.GetParadeStudy] in favor of protecting the safety and sanity of the [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] on [Target.GetName].

label.en: No! We need to study this.

tooltips.zh: 这将会提升该机遇产出的凝聚力。
tooltips.en: This will increase the amount of unity the opportunity will produce.

label.zh: 包好它，我不希望这个现象散布开去。
label.en: Contain it, we can't let this phenomenon spread.

options.script:
name = situation.1080.c
set_situation_flag = contained_the_mass

label.zh: 它可以赐予我们神圣的智慧。
label.en: It could teach us of the Divine.

tooltips.zh: 这将会提升该机遇产出的凝聚力。
tooltips.en: This will increase the amount of unity the opportunity will produce.

descriptions.zh: 此前的传言一语成谶了：§Y[This.GetName]§!上的§Y恐怖负相物质§!正在我们的现实上撕开裂口，打开通向另一个世界裂隙。这一现象突破了抑制措施，开始在[This.GetName]上蔓延。所有与这一维度接触的事物，哪怕是不经意地透过观测设备查看，都让进行观察的[Owner.GetTeamMember]感受到剧烈的痛苦。我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]担忧事态还可能进一步扩大，但同时保证只要再花一点时间他们就能解开另一个维度的奥秘了。
descriptions.en: What was only rumors before has now been confirmed: the §YHorrific Inverse Mass§! on §Y[This.GetName]§! has been tearing holes in our very reality, opening rifts into another world. The phenomenon has breached the containment procedures and now seems to be expanding into [This.GetName]'s capital. Any contact with the dimension, even inadvertently through the lens of observational devices, causes intense distress on the observing [Owner.GetTeamMember]. Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] are worried that his can spread even further but also promise that with just a bit more time they can unlock the secrets of the other dimension.

descriptions.zh: 此前的传言一语成谶了：§Y[This.GetName]§!上的§Y恐怖负相物质§!正在我们的现实上撕开裂口，打开通向一个纯粹邪恶世界的裂隙。任何窥视裂隙的人都会立刻陷入疯狂，直到数个小时之后才停止尖叫。我们的牧师们长年以来都在思考着我们所击败的这一实体的存在而一无所获，如今却说他们即将顿悟了。“再给我们点时间吧！”他们恳求，然而我们的科学家警告，如果再不加以控制，事态可能会变得不可收拾。
descriptions.en: What was only rumors before has now been confirmed; the §YHorrific Inverse Mass§! on §Y[This.GetName]§! has been tearing holes in our very reality into a world of pure evil. Anyone even glancing towards one of the rifts needs hours of solitude just to stop screaming. As our priests have been contemplating the very existence of the being we defeated for several years now without any great epiphany, they say that they are approaching one now. "We just need a bit more time!" They implore, while our scientist warn us that the process might be irreversible if we allow it to go on much further.

label.en: The discoveries are worth the risk!

label.zh: 我们需要见到真正的神圣视界。
label.en: We need to see the true vision of the Divine.
No, the danger is too great.

descriptions.zh: 可能我们狂妄自大过了头。尽管在§Y[This.GetName]§!上的§Y恐怖负相物质§!仍封存良好，但整颗行星还是在被它从内而外逐渐撕碎。虽然我们在研究其他维度时获得的科学突破是革命性的，但它对行星的负担同样不可承受。尽管几乎没有[Owner.GetScientistPlural]有信心能控制住反应，但这并不是完全没有机会！在[This.GetName]的居民正在逐渐登船离开[This.GetPlanetHabitat]时，无数的空间裂口张开了。很快事态将会变得不可挽回。
descriptions.en: Perhaps our hubris was too great. §Y[This.GetName]§! is being ripped apart from the inside as the §YHorrific Inverse Mass§! is still sequestered on it. While the breakthroughs we have had in the sciences from studying the other dimension are revolutionary, its strain on the world has been immense. Few [Owner.GetScientistPlural] believe that they can still stabilize the reaction, but there is a chance! As inhabitants of [This.GetName] board transport ships to leave the [This.GetPlanetHabitat], an innumerable amount of rifts are opening up. The point of no return is fast approaching.

descriptions.zh: 可能我们狂妄自大过了头。尽管在§Y[This.GetName]§!上的§Y恐怖负相物质§!仍封存良好，但整颗行星还是在被它从内而外逐渐撕碎。虽然我们对这个纯粹痛苦的维度有了许多了解，但它对行星的负担同样不可承受。几乎没有牧师敢保证自己能净化这团物质，但并不是完全没有机会！在[This.GetName]的居民正在逐渐登船离开[This.GetPlanetHabitat]时，无数的空间裂口张开了。很快事态将会变得不可挽回。
descriptions.en: Perhaps our hubris was too great. §Y[This.GetName]§! is being ripped apart from the inside as the §YHorrific Inverse Mass§! is still sequestered on it. While we have learned much about the dimension of pure pain, the strain on the world has been immense. Few priests still believe that they purify the mass, but there is a chance! As inhabitants of [This.GetName] board transport ships to leave the [This.GetPlanetHabitat], an innumerable amount of rifts are opening up. The point of no return is fast approaching.

label.zh: 我们做得太过头了，恐怕已经无力回天。
label.en: We have come too far to see it end now.

label.zh: 如果我们就此止步就是向恶咒认输！
label.en: If we stop now the Anathema wins!
Get rid of it, by any means necessary!

descriptions.zh: 晴空永远消失了，它不是被乌云荫蔽，而是被纯粹的虚空所笼罩。§Y[This.GetName]§!所残存的只有漂浮在虚无之海的陆地碎片。所有来不及逃离[This.GetPlanetHabitat]的人在其上的每一刻都在承受着无上的痛苦。我们为专家们争取到了尽可能多的时间。一个扭曲而恼人的声音回响在行星的上空：§R“对寸——回—回归于我——吧。”§!
descriptions.en: The sky is gone. It's not covered by clouds. It has been replaced by a pure void. All that remains of §Y[This.GetName]§! is patches of ground in the ocean of nothingness. Everyone left on the [This.GetPlanetHabitat] is suffering pure agony for every instant that passes. We have bought as much time as we could for our specialists. A distorted and disturbed voice echoes from the world beyond §R"YesS re-reTURN to mee-."§!

descriptions.zh: 在击败了神秘堡垒之后，它的一个舱段漂浮在太空中，我们决定将其带回[Target.Solar_System.GetName]，成为我们[Owner.GetParadeStudy]的一部分。一些[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]在进入§Y神秘堡垒舱室§!深处后都失踪了。自它运抵§Y[Target.GetName]§!时，我们每天都派出[Owner.GetTeamMemberPlural]进入探索，但今天早些时候它内部的某些结构发生了变化。舱门自发地折叠消失了，只留下无尽的舱壁嘲笑着我们的工作人员们的狂怒。我们仍能与被困的[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]取得联络，但我们目前没有想出能不破坏该结构为前提的营救方案。看来神秘堡垒还有最后一个未解之谜。
descriptions.en: After defeating the Enigmatic Fortress, a section of it was floating in space, so we decided to bring it to [Target.Solar_System.GetName] to be a part of our [Owner.GetParadeStudy]. Several [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have gone missing inside the depths of the §YChamber from the Fortress§!. Ever since it arrived on §Y[Target.GetName]§!, we have had [Owner.GetTeamMemberPlural] exploring it daily, yet something inside the structure shifted earlier today. Doors folded in on themselves, leaving only sheer walls for our agents to rail against. We can still communicate with the trapped [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural], but we have no clear idea of getting them out without damaging the structure. It seems that the Enigmatic Fortress had one last secret.

tooltips.en: This will reduce the amount of unity the opportunity will produce.

label.zh: 我们承担不起切割舱室的代价。
label.en: We can't risk despoiling the Chamber.

label.zh: 我们可以用这个方法来关押罪大恶极之人。
label.en: We could use this technology to contain our undesirables.

tooltips.zh: 这将会提升该机遇产出的凝聚力。
tooltips.en: This will increase the amount of unity the opportunity will produce.

descriptions.zh:
§Y虚空孳孽毒腺§!中的污染物发生了严重泄露！这些毁灭性的毒液已经污染了我们§Y[Target.GetName]§!的[Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower]资源，迫使我们从其他的星球运输[Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower]来缓解这场自作自受的大干旱。这种演化出来用以杀死硕大无朋的巨型太空兽群、溶穿厚重装甲板的毒液对任何不慎摄入的[Owner.GetSpeciesName]来说都剧毒无比。我们现在得研究如何解决这场危机。

我们是要在[Target.GetPlanetHabitat]从分子层面上净化掉所有虚空孳孽的基因，或是慢慢地将这些毒液过滤掉，以继续进行我们的[Owner.GetParadeStudy]？
descriptions.en:
The containment for the §YVoidspawn's Venom Gland§! has sprung a leak! The devastating venom has now poisoned our [Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower] supply on §Y[Target.GetName]§!, forcing us to ferry [Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower] from other worlds to alleviate the self-imposed drought. The venom, which evolved to incapacitate titanic Space Fauna and melt through hull plating, has proven to be incredibly toxic to any [Owner.GetSpeciesName] that has ingested it. We now must decide how to handle this crisis.

Do we perform a molecular purge of all Voidspawn DNA on our [Target.GetPlanetHabitat], or do we slowly filter the venom out so that we can proceed with the [Owner.GetParadeStudy]?

descriptions.zh:

我们是要在[Target.GetPlanetHabitat]从分子层面上净化掉所有虚空孳孽的基因，或是慢慢地将这些毒液过滤掉，以继续进行我们的[Owner.GetParadeStudy]？

我们是要在[Target.GetPlanetHabitat]从分子层面上净化掉所有虚空孳孽的基因，或是慢慢地将这些毒液过滤掉，以继续进行我们的[Owner.GetParadeStudy]？
descriptions.en:
The containment for the §YVoidspawn's Venom Gland§! has sprung a leak! The devastating venom has now poisoned our [Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower] supply on §Y[Target.GetName]§!, forcing us to ferry [Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower] from other worlds to alleviate the self-imposed drought. The venom, which evolved to incapacitate titanic Space Fauna and melt through hull plating, has proven to interact corrosively when exposed to our coolant. Any units using the contaminated coolant quickly stopped functioning. We now must decide how to handle this crisis.

Do we perform a molecular purge of all Voidspawn DNA on our [Target.GetPlanetHabitat], or do we slowly filter the venom out so that we can proceed with the [Owner.GetParadeStudy]?

label.zh: 控制污染的扩散，保障[Owner.GetParadeStudy]继续进行。
label.en: Contain the spread but don't cancel the [Owner.GetParadeStudy].

tooltips.zh: 在污染清理干净之后再举办[Owner.GetParadeStudy]。
tooltips.en: Pause the [Owner.GetParadeStudy] until the contaminant is cleared up.

label.zh: 把污染物和那个毒腺一并清理出去！
label.en: Cleanse the world of the contaminant and the venom sack!

tooltips.zh: 取消[Owner.GetParadeStudy]以尽快清理这颗星球。
tooltips.en: Cancel the [Owner.GetParadeStudy] in favor of quickly cleaning the world.

descriptions.zh: 在几个月的努力后，我们在§Y[Target.GetName]§!上的[Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower]资源终于移除了虚空孳孽污染变得清洁可用。这并不是徒劳一场，反之，我们在[Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower]中学到了许多异星生理学的基本知识，并且已经准备好继续进行[Owner.GetParadeStudy]。我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]认为，只要[Owner.GetParadeStudy]的研究得出结果，他们就能以其提升[Target.GetName]的生活质量。
descriptions.en: After many months of effort, our [Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower] supply on §Y[Target.GetName]§! is finally clear of the Voidspawn Contaminant. It was not a wasted effort, as we have learned much from the xeno-biology present in our [Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower] and are now ready to proceed with the [Owner.GetParadeStudy]. Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] now think that they can improve life on [Target.GetName] with the these discoveries once the [Owner.GetParadeStudy] concludes.

descriptions.zh: 我们遗留在噬星者最终被击杀的地方的探测器汇报，那具遗骸的一部分开始和恒星融为一体。释放的能量增进了恒星活动，但我们的计算表明，由于移除了§Y卵鞘§!，这仍不足以让§Y[dead_stellarite.solar_system.GetName]§!恒星系恢复原有的光明。如果我们让货运飞船返回，我们有希望可以重新点亮这颗恒星。
descriptions.en: The observation probes we had left behind at the site of the Stellar Devourer's final demise report that portions of the body have started to merge back into the star. The energy seems to have increased stellar activity, but with the removal of the §YEgg Sac§!, our calculations state that it won't be enough to restore the §Y[dead_stellarite.solar_system.GetName]§! system to its former luster. If we turn our transport ship back now, we could still potentially reignite the star.

label.zh: 归还卵鞘，并看看我们能做些什么。
label.en: Return the Egg Sac and see what can be done.

tooltips.zh: 取消[Owner.GetParadeStudy]以尝试重新点亮[dead_stellarite.system.GetName]。
tooltips.en: Cancel the [Owner.GetParadeStudy] in favor of attempting to reignite the [dead_stellarite.system.GetName] star.

label.en: No, we are bringing the Egg Sac to [Target.GetName].

descriptions.zh:
[Target.GetAdj]双星系统的光芒照耀着我们的货运飞船驶入[Target.capital_scope.Solar_System.GetName]。

他们的货物，数以百万计的微型噬星者，在绝对零度下储存，以确保它们稳定而惰性，直到将他们送到恒星系的主恒星。货运飞船需要继续保持静默飞行一段时间，以便进一步渗透[Target.GetSpeciesAdj]首都。
descriptions.en:
The light of the [Target.GetAdj] twin stars shone down on our transport ship as it entered the [Target.capital_scope.Solar_System.GetName] system.

Their cargo - millions of tiny Stellar Devourers - is stored at absolute zero, which keeps them docile and inert until they are ready to be introduced to the system's primary star. The transport ship will have to go dark for a while as they further infiltrate the [Target.GetSpeciesAdj] capital.

descriptions.zh:
构成[Target.GetName]核心的星光三重奏照耀着我们的货运飞船的船体驶入[Target.capital_scope.Solar_System.GetName]星系。

他们的货物，数以百万计的微型噬星者，在绝对零度下储存，以确保它们稳定而惰性，直到将他们送到恒星系的主恒星。货运飞船需要继续保持静默飞行一段时间，以便进一步渗透[Target.GetSpeciesAdj]首都。
descriptions.en:
The trio of lights that form the heart of the [Target.GetName] glinted off our transport ship's hull as it entered the S[Target.capital_scope.Solar_System.GetName] system.

Their cargo - millions of tiny Stellar Devourers - is stored at absolute zero, which keeps them docile and inert until they are ready to be introduced to the system's primary star. The transport ship will have to go dark for a while as they further infiltrate the [Target.GetSpeciesAdj] capital.

descriptions.zh:
在踏出了驶向赐予[Target.capital_star.GetName]生命恒星的旅途的第一步之后，我们的货运飞船仍在继续挺进[Target.GetName]宇域。

他们的货物，数以百万计的微型噬星者，在绝对零度下储存，以确保它们稳定而惰性，直到将他们送到恒星系的主恒星。货运飞船需要继续保持静默飞行一段时间，以便进一步渗透[Target.GetSpeciesAdj]首都。
descriptions.en:
After having finished the first leg of their journey to the life-giving [Target.capital_star.GetName] star, our transport ship ventures further into [Target.GetName] space.

Their cargo - millions of tiny Stellar Devourers - is stored at absolute zero, which keeps them docile and inert until they are ready to be introduced to the system's primary star. The transport ship will have to go dark for a while as they further infiltrate the [Target.GetSpeciesAdj] capital.

options.script: name = PROCEED

descriptions.zh: 运载噬星者的货运飞船已经通过了恒星系的安全检查，其中使用的密码是此前由间谍首脑[spynetwork.leader.GetName]所捕获的，这对顺利通行至关重要。我们的操作员已经开始将这些噬星者宝宝重新解冻以恢复其活动。货运飞船将再次瞄准恒星系的首要恒星，作为这次旅途的终点。
descriptions.en: Our Stellar Devourer transport has cleared the system's security check - the security codes that Spymaster [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has been gathering were crucial for passing into the system. Our operatives have started the heating procedure to get the baby Stellar Devourers moving. They will again aim for the system's primary star for the transport ship's final voyage.

options.script: name = ACKNOWLEDGED

titles.zh: 离开货运飞船，进入燃烧的等离子体
titles.en: Out of the Transport Ship, Into the Burning Plasma

descriptions.zh:
我们已经收到来自间谍首脑[spynetwork.leader.GetName]的密电：一切就绪。我们的操作员已经开始弃船操作，只保留下核心船员。一旦舰船加速到最大的亚光速航速，他们也会在飞船撞击这个星系的首要恒星之前脱离，以确保我们不留下任何蛛丝马迹。

噬星者宝宝们已经开始躁动不安。如果我们再不快点执行操作，它们可能都要开始打起飞船燃料的主意了。
descriptions.en:
We have received word back from Spymaster [spynetwork.leader.GetName]: everything is ready. Our operatives have already started abandoning the transport ship, leaving only a skeleton crew behind. Once the ship hits its maximum sublight speed, they too will escape just before the transport crashes into the system's primary star, ensuring we leave no evidence behind.

The Stellar Devourers have started to get quite agitated. If we don't commence the operation soon, they might make their way into the transport's fuel supply.

descriptions.zh:
我们干预行动的最后证据很快在恒星的日冕层熔化了。我们的传感器在撞击后的一瞬间焚毁，但这足以证明我们已经成功地感染了§Y[From.target.capital_star.GetName]§!。

我们已经为这个恒星系写下了残酷而寒冷的终章。
descriptions.en:
The last proof of our tampering quickly melted inside the star's corona. Our sensors burned up moments after impact, but that was enough to confirm that we had successfully infested §Y[From.target.capital_star.GetName]§!.

We may just have doomed an entire solar system to a cruel, cold death.

descriptions.zh:
我们的[capital_star.GetName]遭遇了一场异常的恒星活动低谷期。由于温度的降低，恒星黑子以史无前例的数量大量出现，让恒星的辐射发生了非常明显的衰弱。

[capital_scope.GetName]上的居民已经开始囤积核热毯，减少外出。希望我们能尽早回到温暖的日子。
descriptions.en:
We are experiencing an unusually inactive solar cycle from [capital_star.GetName]. Sunspots have appeared in unprecedented numbers because of the reduced temperature of our star, leading to a noticeable decrease in solar radiation.

Inhabitants of [capital_scope.GetName] have taken to stocking up on fission-powered blankets and minimizing trips outside. Hopefully, we will return to warmer times soon.

descriptions.zh:
我们的[capital_star.GetName]遭遇了一场异常的恒星活动低谷期。由于温度的降低，恒星黑子以史无前例的数量大量出现，让恒星的辐射发生了非常明显的衰弱。

我们已经分派了更多的能量用于产热，并指示所有子个体凑成团簇一同行动以减少热量散失。我们一定能熬过去的。
descriptions.en:
We are experiencing an unusually inactive solar cycle from [capital_star.GetName]. Sunspots have appeared in unprecedented numbers because of the reduced temperature of our star, leading to a noticeable decrease in solar radiation.

We have allocated more energy to our heating budget and have instructed all drones to huddle closer to each other to preserve heat. We will endure this.

descriptions.zh:
我们的[capital_star.GetName]遭遇了一场异常的恒星活动低谷期。由于温度的降低，恒星黑子以史无前例的数量大量出现，让恒星的辐射发生了非常明显的衰弱。

尽管这场骚动触动了我们共同本能深处的恐惧，但鉴于我们知晓母星此前造成的破坏：我们将坚持下去。我们已分配更多能量用于供暖我们的庇护所，而我们的共生体们也将学会为了取暖而更加紧密地依偎在一起。
descriptions.en:
We are experiencing an unusually inactive solar cycle from [capital_star.GetName]. Sunspots have appeared in unprecedented numbers because of the reduced temperature of our star, leading to a noticeable decrease in solar radiation.

Though this disturbance strikes fear into the core of our shared instincts, knowing the damage our home star has wreaked before: we shall endure. We have allocated more energy for heating our sheltered dwellings, and our symbionts shall learn to huddle closer to each other for warmth.

descriptions.zh: §Y[capital_star.GetName]§!内部的聚变反应持续低迷的时长前所未见。由于其辐照能量的骤减，[capital_scope.GetName]上已经发生了多种生态灾害，如果继续下去，我们可能将面临冰河时期。所有的空间站和定居点都遭遇到了相似的情况。我们的[owner.GetScientistPlural]确信一定有什么蹊跷，希望能研究[capital_star.GetName]。
descriptions.en: The fusion chain reaction inside of §Y[capital_star.GetName]§! has now been on a steady downturn for an unprecedented amount of time. There are active ecological disasters on [capital_scope.GetName] due to the lowered radiation, and if this continues, we might be looking at an ice age. All stations and other places of residence in the system are suffering from similar issues. Our [owner.GetScientistPlural] are sure that there is something abnormal afoot and desire to investigate [capital_star.GetName].

label.zh: 查查到底发生了什么事！
label.en: Figure out what is going on!

descriptions.zh: §R[capital_star.GetName]被微型噬星者感染了！§!我们不明白这些星神兽幼体到底是怎么跑到我们的恒星上的，明明它们不具有任何超光速能力。我们可以在未来对其进行研究，但当下我们最要紧的是研究如何停止它们的寄生，否则我们的整个首都就要被彻底冻死了。
descriptions.en: §R[capital_star.GetName] is infested with tiny Stellar Devourers!§! We have no clue how these neonate leviathans have managed to get to our star as they don't seem to possess any FTL capabilities. We can uncover all that later. For now, we need to discover a way to stop the parasites before our capital freezes over.

label.en: Well, get them out of there!

descriptions.zh:
今天对[owner.GetName]而言是地狱般的一天，我们的首都恒星§Y[target.GetName]§!熄灭了。尽管有数百万人撤离，但这对于我们遭受的打击来说不过杯水车薪。我们的首都永远地陷入了冰河时期。[target.GetName]则缩水成了一颗褐矮星，这就意味着这个恒星系里任何生命都不再适合生存了。
我们推测这些噬星者很有可能是由§Y[star_infesters.GetName]§!送到我们的恒星上的，现在我们要他们血债血偿。
descriptions.en:
Today was a terrible day for the [owner.GetName], as our capital star §Y[target.GetName]§! went out. Despite having evacuated many millions it only slightly softens the blow. Our capital is forever lost to a new and permanent ice age. [target.GetName] itself has shrunken to become a brown dwarf star, meaning life remaining in the system will permanently be diminished.
We know that these Devourers were purposely introduced to our star by the §Y[star_infesters.GetName]§! - and now they shall suffer.

descriptions.zh:
今天对[owner.GetName]而言是地狱般的一天，我们的首都恒星§Y[target.GetName]§!熄灭了。尽管有数百万人撤离，但这对于我们遭受的打击来说不过杯水车薪。我们的首都永远地陷入了冰河时期。[target.GetName]则缩水成了一颗褐矮星，这就意味着这个恒星系里任何生命都不再适合生存了。
很遗憾，究竟是什么把这些噬星者带到我们星系的仍不得而知。目前是灾后重建的时候了。
descriptions.en:
Today was a terrible day for the [owner.GetName], as our capital star §Y[target.GetName]§! went out. Despite having evacuated many millions it only slightly softens the blow. Our capital is forever lost to a new and permanent ice age. [target.GetName] itself has shrunken to become a brown dwarf star, meaning life remaining in the system will permanently be diminished.
Sadly, this freak occurrence that delivered the Stellar Devourers to our system will remain a mystery. For now, we must rebuild.
